title: In This World You Sneeze When Someone Thinks Of You
description: Ryo sneezes 300 times a day, and his whole class is betting on who his secret admirer is. Who thinks about you the most? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Ryo: 15-year-old Japanese boy, spiky black hair, red nose, black gakuran school uniform with gold buttons, white sneakers, tissue box under one arm, no hat
characters.Kuro: old black shelter dog with a gray muzzle, droopy ears, slightly chubby, faded blue collar
characters.Hana: 15-year-old Japanese girl, long wavy chestnut hair with a pink headband, navy sailor school uniform with a white collar and red neckerchief, white socks, brown loafers

scenes.say: In this world, you sneeze whenever someone thinks of you. Most people sneeze twice a day. Since last Monday, Ryo has been sneezing three hundred times a day.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Quiet 1990s Japanese classroom in morning light, a student at the front sneezes once politely into her sleeve. [4-7s] Medium shot of Ryo at his desk by the window sneezing so hard his papers fly up. [7-10s] Close-up of Ryo with a red nose pulling a tissue from the box under his arm, eyes watering.

scenes.say: Last Monday was also the day his family adopted Kuro, an old shelter dog nobody else wanted. Ryo barely noticed. He was too busy being famous for sneezing.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside a small animal shelter with metal kennels, Ryo's mother kneels beside Kuro, who wags his tail slowly. [4-7s] At the doorway of Ryo's family house, Kuro watches Ryo leave for school, ears drooping. [7-10s] In the classroom, two classmates point and giggle as Ryo sneezes into a tissue.

scenes.say: So the class decides he has a secret admirer. The clues: it's nonstop at school, it stops the second he gets home, and it never happens on weekends. Everyone bets on Hana.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In the classroom at lunch, three classmates huddle around Ryo's desk, whispering and grinning. [4-7s] Medium shot of Hana at the desk behind Ryo, looking up from her lunch box, confused. [7-10s] Close-up of Ryo glancing back at Hana and sneezing twice, blushing.

scenes.say: But on Thursday he stays home sick and doesn't sneeze once. Hana isn't there. On Friday he walks out the door, takes three steps, and sneezes four times.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In Ryo's small bedroom, Ryo lies in bed under a blanket, reading a comic and not sneezing, Kuro asleep on the floor beside him. [4-7s] Friday morning outside Ryo's family house, Ryo steps through the front gate. [7-10s] On the quiet street three steps from the gate, Ryo doubles over sneezing.

scenes.say: He turns around. Kuro is sitting in the front window, nose pressed against the glass, watching the exact spot where Ryo vanished. His mom says he sits there until four. Every day.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the street outside Ryo's family house, Ryo turns around slowly. [4-7s] Through the front window of the house, Kuro sits with his gray muzzle pressed against the glass, eyes fixed on the gate. [7-10s] Close-up of Ryo's face softening, a tissue frozen halfway to his nose.

scenes.say: Now Kuro walks him to school, waits at the gate, and the sneezing barely happens. Hana lost the bet. In this world, you sneeze when someone thinks of you. Kuro never stops.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Morning on the quiet residential street, Ryo walks to school with Kuro trotting beside him on a leash. [4-7s] At the school gate, Kuro lies down to wait as Ryo pats his head. [7-10s] In the classroom, Ryo sneezes once at his desk and smiles toward the window, where Kuro is a small dark shape waiting at the gate.
